schema_doc: TraceFlow Trace v1.0 — FROZEN. Every step must satisfy: { step:int, line:int, variables:object, output:[string], changes:[string], explanation:string }. Optional UI hints (kind, label, condition, condition_result) may be added but are NOT required by the frontend and MUST NOT be relied on by future parser/AI code.

samples.name: For Loop — Sum 1..3
samples.description: Compute the sum of integers from 1 to 3 using a for loop.

steps.explanation: The variable sum is declared and initialized to 0. It will accumulate the running total. Next, the for loop begins.
steps.label: Declare sum

steps.explanation: The loop counter i is initialized to 1. The condition i <= 3 will now be evaluated before the body executes.
steps.label: Initialize i = 1

steps.explanation: The condition 1 <= 3 is true, so the loop body will execute. Nothing has changed yet.
steps.label: Check i <= 3  →  true

steps.explanation: The current value of i (1) is added to sum. sum changes from 0 to 1. The loop will now increment i.
steps.label: sum += i  →  sum = 1

steps.explanation: The counter i is incremented to 2. The loop condition will be re-checked.
steps.label: i++  →  i = 2

steps.explanation: 2 <= 3 is true, so the loop body runs again. sum will be updated next.
steps.label: Check i <= 3  →  true

steps.explanation: i (2) is added to sum. sum changes from 1 to 3.
steps.label: sum += i  →  sum = 3

steps.explanation: i is incremented to 3. The condition is re-checked.
steps.label: i++  →  i = 3

steps.explanation: 3 <= 3 is true, so the body runs one last time.
steps.label: Check i <= 3  →  true

steps.explanation: i (3) is added to sum. sum changes from 3 to 6. This is the final iteration.
steps.label: sum += i  →  sum = 6

steps.explanation: i becomes 4. The condition will now be checked once more.
steps.label: i++  →  i = 4

steps.explanation: 4 <= 3 is false, so the loop exits. Execution moves to the print statement.
steps.label: Check i <= 3  →  false

steps.explanation: The final value of sum (6) is printed to the console. The program ends here.
steps.label: System.out.println(sum)

samples.name: If / Else — Grade Check
samples.description: Evaluate a condition and print a branch-specific message.

steps.explanation: The variable score is initialized to 72. This value will be tested against 60 next.
steps.label: Declare score = 72

steps.explanation: 72 >= 60 evaluates to true. The if branch will execute; the else branch will be skipped.
steps.label: Check score >= 60  →  true

steps.explanation: Because the condition was true, "Pass" is printed. The else block is not executed.
steps.label: System.out.println("Pass")

samples.name: While Loop — Countdown
samples.description: Print n down to 1 using a while loop.

steps.explanation: The variable n is initialized to 3. This value controls how many times the loop runs.
steps.label: Declare n = 3

steps.explanation: 3 > 0 is true, so the loop body runs.
steps.label: Check n > 0  →  true

steps.explanation: The current value of n (3) is printed to the console.
steps.label: System.out.println(n)  →  3

steps.explanation: n is decremented to 2. The condition will be re-evaluated at the top of the loop.
steps.label: n--  →  n = 2

steps.explanation: 2 > 0 is true, so the body runs again.
steps.label: Check n > 0  →  true

steps.explanation: The value 2 is appended to the output.
steps.label: System.out.println(n)  →  2

steps.explanation: n is decremented to 1.
steps.label: n--  →  n = 1

steps.explanation: 1 > 0 is true, so the body runs one more time.
steps.label: Check n > 0  →  true

steps.explanation: The value 1 is appended to the output.
steps.label: System.out.println(n)  →  1

steps.explanation: n is decremented to 0.
steps.label: n--  →  n = 0

steps.explanation: 0 > 0 is false, so the loop terminates. The program ends here.
steps.label: Check n > 0  →  false
